test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A train P going at the speed of 58 km/hr completely passes train Q of length 238 m, going in the same direction on parallel tracks, at 27 km/hr, in 7.5 minutes. How much time (in seconds) will P take to cross completely train R of length 123 m, going at 38 km/hr in the opposite direction?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Relative Speed** (Same direction) = 58 − 27 = 31 km/hr.

**Total Distance** (P + Q) = Speed × Time = (31 × 5/18) × (7.5 × 60) = (155/18) × 450 = 3875 m.

**Length of P** = 3875 − 238 = 3637 m.

**Relative Speed** (Opposite direction with R) = 58 + 38 = 96 km/hr = 96 × 5/18 = 80/3 m/s.

**Time to cross R** = (Length of P + Length of R) ÷ Relative Speed = (3637 + 123) ÷ (80/3) = 3760 × 3/80 = 47 × 3 = 141 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 141 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0563c03567bfc042582756e4ebd1100567444dc6a22e72a1ff65e4ef5e1a33c.png] 

**Given:** VP = 58 km/hr, VQ = 27 km/hr, LQ = 238 m, Time₁ = 7.5 min, VR = 38 km/hr, LR = 123 m.

**Formula:** Relative Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

⇒ Relative Speed (P and Q) = 58 − 27 = 31 km/hr = 31 × 5/18 m/s.

⇒ Total Distance = LP + 238 = (31 × 5/18) × (7.5 × 60)

⇒ LP + 238 = (155/18) × 450 ⇒ LP + 238 = 3875

⇒ LP = 3875 − 238 = 3637 m.

⇒ Relative Speed (P and R) = 58 + 38 = 96 km/hr = 96 × 5/18 = 80/3 m/s.

⇒ Time to cross R = (LP + LR) ÷ Rel. Speed = (3637 + 123) ÷ (80/3)

⇒ Time = 3760 × 3 / 80 = 47 × 3 = 141 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 141 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concept

When two objects move in the **same direction**, relative speed = V₁ − V₂. When they move in **opposite directions**, relative speed = V₁ + V₂.

Conversion Factor

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Train Crossing Objects

When a train crosses another train or platform, the total distance covered is the **sum of their lengths** (L₁ + L₂).</p
